You have [b]ONE WEEK[/b] until you dive headfirst into the world of Athens to complete [b]your OWN Rhapsody[/b]!!! Experience all that this world has to offer - its twists, turns, and shenanigans are all about to be discovered by [b]YOU[/b]!!!

notes.title: Athenian Rhapsody - Full Game Releasing May 14th!!!
notes.notes:
[h2]Athenian Rhapsody is releasing on May 14th!!![/h2]

You can finally experience the ENTIRE world of Athens for yourself on [b]May 14th!![/b] Are you excited??? I might be!!! It's been real, it's been fun... Some might even say it's been real fun!

The full game of Athenian Rhapsody comes to you at full force - prepare for an all-new adventure full of characters to bond with, pathways to travel, stories to experience, and mysteries to unravel... All at your own pace. 

[b]My Rhapsody is almost complete - Now it's almost time to begin yours![/b]

You can redeem your Tokens from Thunder Goober's Personality Dungeon in the full version of Athenian Rhapsody to receive special armors, items, and even a [i]friendly little visit from an old friend! A [b]BURGER[/b] friend!!! Are you excited?? For the burger??? Again?????[/i]

notes.title: PAX East 2024 + Release Date Following
notes.notes:
[h2]Athenian Rhapsody is attending [b]PAX East 2024[/b] with a [b]RELEASE DATE[/b] following shortly![/h2]

[u][b]Athenian Rhapsody at PAX:[/b][/u]
Like stated in the title, Athenian Rhapsody will be at PAX East 2024 showcasing an exclusive in-person demo featuring the character Uncle Billiard. This demo is only available to convention goers at the moment, and has been designed to be a more immersive and quick experience for the player.

We've also ordered several thousand Thunder Goober hats for attendees to wear around the convention and cosplay everyone's favorite wizard (irritable bowel syndrome sold separately). PAX East is the only place you'll be able to obtain these hats at the moment, and they're made of very sturdy material too so they'll definitely serve as a long lasting pre-launch souvenir.

I also plan to do [b]daily giveaways[/b] of Athenian Rhapsody through digitally redeemable codes which will be sent to winners upon the release of the game - I'm not sure of the exact details yet, but during the show day submissions will be collected and winners will be announced at the end of each day.

[u][b]Release Date Announcement:[/b][/u]
We're just about ready to start our full rollout of Athenian Rhapsody and announce our planned release date to the public - this will most likely be ready within several weeks of PAX East through a brand new trailer. This will be extremely exciting as we have lots of collaborations, content, and exciting things planned for the rollout.

Please stay alert with open eyes and ears after PAX so that you don't miss any new exciting pieces of news from Athenian Rhapsody in regards to release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40954853/e9566925d3f5047da741bac02c29548c43cb951a.png[/img]

notes.title: Nerfed the Slide Puzzle!
notes.notes:
Hey there my friends,

In this small update, I fixed the Gooberville check not resetting upon starting a new game as well as nerfed the slide puzzle.

Often, it would start with impossible combinations, meaning that they are not solvable. Quite frankly I think this is hilarious. But as we all know, they think it's funny 'till it's not, and at some point it did have to be nerfed. While we do a little trolling, yes, we also do a little bit of fixing.

I'll be adding controller glyphs in the tutorial for Steam Deck soon as well!

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Bug Fixes + Stuff I Had To Do for Porting
notes.notes:
Based on your feedback, I've fixed some minor bugs and one token crash - thanks for the help everyone! If I accidently messed anything up, let me know and I'll fix it ASAP! I did a trial run myself and earned a quick Token as well... 

I've also gotten the demo ready to start to be ported - It will be ready by early summertime baby! Can't wait for that, and now I'm finally going to be working on The Rhap again. Stay well dogs!
